title: Tenma Saki — Magic Show Assistant!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Seaside School - Day 3
Beach

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We will now have some free time.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Groups that wish to practice what they'll be presenting later this afternoon may use the practice area one at a time in an orderly manner.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's really happening this afternoon... I'm starting to get a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I am too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll be fine! I mean, we practiced sooo much yesterday☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree! I always feel a little nervous just before an event...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I've been finding that practice is the best way to give myself the confidence I need. I'm sure we'll do great.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right. Kohane's been performing in a bunch of live events.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Since a veteran like her is saying this about us, I guess we should feel more confident about ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, then why don't we relax at the beach a little while we wait for our turn to practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's actually somewhere I wanna check out☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Where?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-daah! Look at all these big rocks♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, wow...!
And isn't that a tidal pool?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so. It must be low tide right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We might be able to see some fish and other sea creatures if we're lucky!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I found a starfish!
Look☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Wait, it's okay to touch starfish?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This one doesn't seem to mind. The way it waves its arms is so cute too☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-It is... Oh, it just moved...
It's so big too. Maybe bigger than your hand...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, it is...
It's bigger than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Are starfish not your thing?
How about you, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure, since you managed to find one so fast.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What...?!
You're not scared, Kohane...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I thought it would be softer. Huh? Are starfish supposed to feel this warm...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It is?
Maybe I'll try touching it too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You too, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Kohane was brave enough to, so I feel like I shouldn't be this afraid of it. I'm gonna touch it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you for letting us pet you, Mr. Starfish! Bye bye♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there's a little crab over here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Hehe. It's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Where?
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I think there's something stuck between these rocks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There is? Where?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there! Right above where the crab is! Wait... Is that a sea slug?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? I've never seen one before. This is what sea slugs look like?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I always thought that they could only live underwater. Is it really okay for it to get caught out in the sun like this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... It might've gotten stuck between these rocks as the tide pulled away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right. Doesn't this mean that the sun will dry it out before the tide comes back?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What? No!
We have to get it back in the water!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
B-Back in the water...?
You're not touching it, are you, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Want me to do it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I was okay with touching that starfish, so I should be fine now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess I should be gentle with it... Gently, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What the...? Th-This is what sea slugs feel like...? It's kinda squishy, but kinda not...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-by the way, sea slugs don't like... Bite, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're doing great, Saki!
You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...!
Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... That was fun...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We got to see so many sea creatures too. A starfish, that little crab, and even a sea slug.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, and I'm glad we managed to save that poor sea slug.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. If you hadn't spotted it, Saki, it might've ended really badly for it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup♪ It might even come back to thank you one day, Saki♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Isn't there a children's story just like that? The one where a boy saves a turtle...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, the group in front of us doesn't seem quite done yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shall we wait here in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (When is it gonna be our turn to practice...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Uh oh...
I'm getting sleepy...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(No, I need to stay awake...
It's our last chance to practice... So...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Why am I back at the beach?
I was just in our room...

Why hello there!
Do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Emu? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Sea Slug
rows.Line:
No, I am not Emu!
I'm the sea slug you saved☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Sea Slug
rows.Line: I was about to be burned to a crisp, but you were there to save me!

rows.Speaker: Sea Slug
rows.Line:
I'm here to thank you for that!
Now, if you'll come with me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What? Where?
Like an underwater castle?

rows.Speaker: Sea Slug
rows.Line:
No, somewhere much more fun!
A place that makes everybody smile!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Isn't this Phoenix Wonderland...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, you came too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Why are you here, Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Saki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's go! Hurry!

rows.Speaker: Sea Slug
rows.Line:
Everyone's waiting for you♪
Let's have lots of fun together, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm still not really sure what's going on... But whatever♪ Hey, wait for me...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Zzz...
Hey, let's go on that one next...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki's sound asleep.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. She seems so happy too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Her dream's probably super wonderhoy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure it is. We should let her rest until it's our turn to practice.
